title: fillmissing
summary: Fill missing entries using constant, neighbor, interpolation, or summary methods.

gpu_support.notes: GPU inputs are gathered before filling.

description: `fillmissing(A, method, ...)` replaces supported missing values while preserving the input shape. Typed-integer input is a mode-gated RunMat extension: integer classes have no standard missing value, so the result is an exact same-class no-op and the optional filled-entry mask is all false. Integer data nested in table variables or cell contents is a separately declared aggregate extension and is classified before resident children are gathered.
behaviors: Tables apply filling variable-by-variable and return a table plus an optional logical mask; incompatible variable/method combinations report an error.
The optional dimension argument may be supplied as `1`, `2`, or as a `"dim", value` pair. Without an explicit dimension, the first non-singleton dimension is used.
The optional logical mask marks entries that were actually filled; missing endpoints left unchanged by a neighbor method are false.
Complex and sparse array filling is not implemented and is rejected instead of replacing an aggregate value.
Current general gaps include `"spline"`, `"pchip"`, `"makima"`, `"mode"`, moving-window, KNN, custom-function, sample-point, known-location, maximum-gap, variable-selection, and append forms.
